vulnerable.en: Its location in a former lake makes it vulnerable to earthquakes and flooding.
vulnerable.zh: 它位于昔日湖泊之上的地理位置，使其极易受到地震和洪水的侵袭。

vulnerable.en: When people no longer know who to trust, they are more vulnerable to post-truth thinking.
vulnerable.zh: 当人们不再知道该信任谁时，他们就更容易受到后真相思维的影响。

vulnerable.en: By day, we were capable hunters, but by night, we were vulnerable.
vulnerable.zh: 白天，我们是有能力出色的猎人，但一到夜晚，我们就变得非常脆弱。

vulnerable.en: Its economy is very vulnerable because almost everything depends on the success of a single product.
vulnerable.zh: 它的经济非常脆弱，因为几乎一切都取决于单一产品的成功。

vulnerable.en: Someone who is emotionally vulnerable has their feelings and emotions easily hurt.
vulnerable.zh: 情感脆弱（emotionally vulnerable）的人是指其感情和情绪容易受到伤害的人。
